description:
Berry trees give two HP-restoring berries and regrow after one real hour; no status-curing berries are distributed. This is a supply rhythm for the current game, not an explanation of the plants’ regional biology. Renzo’s existing habit of taking two and leaving the rest gives that limit a local voice.

Proposed connected situation: show uneven picking and a recently cleared approach to a shared tree. On return, the same usable path and new fruit make ordinary care visible. Leave room for people to disagree about who tends it without making a universally enforced harvesting law or rewarding the player for every restraint.

sections: §12.3: field resources and regrowth; §32: southern pond.

name: Berry regrowth
